bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; expanding definition of shared time pupils; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 126C.01, subdivision 8.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 126C.01, subdivision 8, is amended to read:

Subd. 8.
Shared time pupils.
"Shared time pupils" means those pupils who:
(1) attend public school programs for part of the regular school day; or
(2) attend public school career and technical education programs offered for secondary credit outside of the regular school day;
and who otherwise fulfill the requirements of section 120A.22 by attendance at a nonpublic school.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective for the 2025-2026 school year and later.
